description: KNa₂AuO₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnnm space group. K is bonded in a distorted square co-planar geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All K-O bond lengths are 2.85 Å. Na is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. There is one shorter (2.28 Å) and two longer (2.34 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Au is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent O atoms. Both Au-O bond lengths are 2.04 Å. O is bonded to two equivalent K, three equivalent Na, and one Au atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OK₂Na₃Au octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-60°.
